description:
Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.
When Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {3} to select its second mode, targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Three Steps Ahead, with the copy targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Three Steps Ahead, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Three Steps Ahead.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Three Steps Ahead.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Three Steps Ahead to your hand and creating a copy of Three Steps Ahead targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Three Steps Ahead copy, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
